user_instruction: please search for "online streaming video 3d point map reconstruction" in CVPR 2026, ICLR2026, ICML2026.

allowed_sources: CVPR 2026 official accepted-paper/proceedings sources, including official CVF/OpenAccess pages if available
ICLR 2026 official accepted-paper sources, including official OpenReview venue/group pages if available
ICML 2026 official accepted-paper/proceedings sources, including official conference, OpenReview, or PMLR pages if available
disallowed_sources: Sources outside CVPR 2026, ICLR 2026, or ICML 2026
Preprints, project pages, code repositories, blogs, news, social media, or non-official mirrors unless they are used only to locate an in-scope official venue record
Other years of CVPR, ICLR, or ICML unless logged only as rejected out-of-scope candidates

stages.name: search
stages.notes: Search only the declared 2026 venue scope. Record searched locations, exact queries, browser-render attempts for JavaScript-rendered official venue pages, rejected out-of-scope candidates, and coverage gaps. Do not use out-of-scope sources as evidence.

stages.name: source_triage
stages.notes: Select only in-scope official venue records relevant to online or streaming video 3D point-map reconstruction. Preserve coverage gaps and rejected out-of-scope records.

stages.name: ingest
stages.notes: Preserve raw sources immutably under the run-local raw root and parsed text under the run-local parsed root. Attempt PDF-first ingestion for paper sources.

stages.name: reader
stages.notes: Create one structured source note per ingested source. Do not update topics, synthesis, outputs, index, log, or followups.

stages.name: wiki_update_sources
stages.notes: Integrate source notes into the compact run-local wiki. Every important technical claim in topics must cite run-local source notes.

stages.name: synthesis
stages.notes: Synthesize only from run-local source notes and wiki pages, not raw search snippets. Include trends, conflicts, gaps, and unresolved questions for the scoped 2026 venue results.

stages.name: wiki_update_synthesis
stages.notes: Update the wiki catalog, log, followups, and durable output. Preserve citation traceability to run-local source notes.

stages.name: lint_critic
stages.notes: Check for missing citations, unsupported claims, source-scope violations, weak evidence, coverage gaps, contradictions, and broken links. Do not rewrite wiki pages.
